meta.title: The Bigfoot Campout
meta.teaser: Follow giant footprints and discover who is hiding in the woods!

text: You are camping with Dad under the stars.
Something tall moves behind the bushes.

commands.response: The bushes shake again. Whatever is there is very tall!
Two furry legs hurry into the forest!
Your trail snack is already in your pocket.
You tuck a granola snack into your pocket.
A crunchy granola snack. Good food for a hike!
Your sleeping bags are ready inside. Dad checks both lanterns.
You tell Dad. Together, you switch on your lanterns and follow the sound.
The woods are dark. First, find out what moved!
You tell Dad. Together, you pass the bushes and follow the furry stranger.
You should look before you march into a bush!
The fire crackles. Beyond its light, the forest waits.

default: A cricket chirps. That did not help.
The campfire pops like it is laughing.
Something in the woods goes CRUNCH!
That would make a very strange camping trick.
Dad checks the lanterns and waits for you.
Try checking the bushes.
hints: Something moved nearby. Take a closer look!
LOOK at the BUSHES, then follow it into the woods.
Use LOOK BUSHES, then GO FOREST.

text: At the forest edge, you and Dad find enormous tracks.
Each footprint is longer than your shoe.

commands.response: Five big toes point deeper into the forest.
The muddy tracks are fresh. One has five giant toes!
You follow the giant tracks between the trees.
Which way did it go? The ground may hold a clue.
Only ferns and berries. The tracks are more interesting.
You whisper hello. A squirrel chatters back.
A strip of brown fur is caught on the bark, very high up.
Your snack is safe in your pocket.

default: An owl hoots: Who? Who?
A twig snaps farther ahead.
That does not tell you which way to go.
The trees rustle in the night breeze.
Your lantern makes long, wiggly shadows.
Maybe the huge footprints are a clue.
hints: The ground has a very large clue.
LOOK at the TRACKS before going on.
Use LOOK TRACKS, then GO FOREST.

text: You and Dad follow the tracks to a moonlit creek.
Across the water, the bushes sneeze: AH-CHOO!

commands.response: A huge furry face peeks out, then ducks down!
You call, 'Bless you!' A deep voice says, 'Thank you.'
You hop across three flat stones. The bushes tremble.
The water sparkles. Three flat stones make a safe crossing.
The giant tracks cross the creek and end at the bushes.
The trail ends here. Check the other side of the creek.
The granola smells extra tasty after your hike.

default: AH-CHOO! The bushes sneeze again.
A frog splashes into the creek.
The giant tracks definitely cross the water.
That only makes the hidden stranger giggle.
Moonlight dances on the creek.
Try finding out what is in those bushes.
hints: The sneeze came from across the creek.
LOOK at or TALK to the BUSHES.
Use LOOK BUSHES, TALK BUSHES, or GO CREEK.

text: You and Dad stop as a friendly Bigfoot steps into the moonlight!
He looks hungry, but he also looks ready to run.

commands.response: Bigfoot's eyes light up. He gently takes the snack.
You stay calm and watch. Bigfoot gives you a tiny wave.
You copy Bigfoot's friendly hoot. His eyes grow wide, then he laughs!
You and Dad hurry back to camp to get the camera.
Bigfoot looks at your snack, then politely looks away.
Bigfoot tilts his head. Give him what?
You take one step closer. Bigfoot takes one step back.

default: Bigfoot blinks and waits.
His giant stomach rumbles: GRRRRUMBLE!
A moth circles your lantern.
Bigfoot scratches his fuzzy chin.
That is not quite how you greet a forest giant.
Choose carefully. Bigfoot is watching you.
hints: Your next choice will decide how the meeting ends.
Try LOOK BIGFOOT, TALK BIGFOOT, or GO CAMP. A snack offers another choice.
Use LOOK BIGFOOT, TALK BIGFOOT, or GO CAMP. If you packed it, use GIVE SNACK.

text: THE QUIET SECRET ENDING
You watch quietly as Bigfoot crosses the creek and vanishes into the trees.
Back at camp, you and Dad keep his secret and draw one enormous footprint in your notebook.

commands.response: He is gone, but you will always remember his little wave.
By morning, the creek has washed the giant tracks away.
For just a moment, a huge hand waves between the trees.
You still have your snack for tomorrow's hike.

default: The secret is safe with you.
The forest is peaceful again.
What an amazing camping night!

text: THE BIGFOOT FRIEND ENDING
Bigfoot shares the snack with you and Dad, then shows you his hidden berry patch.
Before sunrise, your new friend gives you a pinecone the size of a football.

commands.response: Bigfoot whispers, 'Same camp next summer?' You say yes!
Your new friend smiles a huge, fuzzy smile.
Bigfoot knows every berry bush and animal trail.
Dad will never guess where the giant pinecone came from.

default: Bigfoot gives you a careful fist bump.
This is the best camping trip ever!
Your new friend makes a happy hooting sound.

text: THE MIXED-UP MESSAGE ENDING
You meant to say hello in Bigfoot language.
Instead, you said, 'My socks taste like pinecones!' Bigfoot laughs so hard that owls fly away.

commands.response: Bigfoot repeats your mixed-up greeting. You and Dad laugh too.
He points at your socks, then pretends to nibble a pinecone.
You and Dad return to camp practicing the correct Bigfoot word for hello.
You still have your snack. Bigfoot is too busy laughing to notice.

default: Somewhere in the woods, Bigfoot is still chuckling.
Bigfoot language is harder than it sounds!
Next time, you will practice the greeting first.

text: THE GIANT FOOTPRINT ENDING
When you and Dad return with the camera, Bigfoot has disappeared.
All you find is one giant footprint and a soft brown hair on a branch.

commands.response: The footprint is real. Dad says it is bigger than a dinner plate!
Two bushes shake far away, then everything is still.
You call hello, but only an owl answers.
You and Dad spend the morning wondering what might have happened.
Maybe Bigfoot would have liked this snack.

default: Maybe you will see Bigfoot next time.
The forest keeps its mystery.
Dad takes a picture of the giant footprint.
